bayts.text: I praise the Enricher, exalted above slumber, and He has been for me in every month and year.
I addressed Him on land and sea, in secret and openly, together with the faithful guide.
And I said: O Lord of creation, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord!
O our Lord, bless with a blessing surpassing every blessing, worthy of a chief,
with a peace no peace can match, upon my means of access to You, the effacer of blame.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And write for him today the glad tidings of the Generous with You, O Lord, an increase that does not depart.
O our Lord, bless with an excellent blessing, with a peace that hastens with the wishes,
upon him to whom I have given my ink for a long time, with the clarity of my love.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And from my ink lead away from him what has grieved (him), O You toward Whom I turn the composing.
O our Lord, bless with a pure blessing, with a peace that subdues Your enemies for me,
upon him to whom I have given my pens for a long time, with the most beneficial words.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And from my pens lead glad tidings to him, O You Who sent him to us as a bearer of glad tidings.
O our Lord, bless with a radiant blessing, with a peace that visits with Your good pleasure,
upon him to whom I have given my paper, with services joined to (those of) Awṭās.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And from my papers lead the aim to him, O You Who spared me Your enemies and sickness.
O our Lord, bless with an ascending blessing, with a peace abiding with what is pleasing,
upon him whose service has drawn out of me all my faults together, and they went out.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And lead joy to him from my services, O Giver Who granted me piety.
O our Lord, bless with a blessing that removes every complaint, with a peace that pleases,
upon him whom I have pleased for years, striving, exiled, suspected.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And lead to him from my services what gladdens, O You Who spared me whoever slandered and was deluded.
And preserve by Your noble Countenance my life from hateful things, and set my affair right.
And make my heart a treasury of the beneficial sciences: for You are the Giver, the All-Knowing.
And make my limbs homelands of Your guidance unto the Gardens, safe from Your enemies.
O our Lord, bless with a blessing that draws to Your good pleasure, that overcomes Your enemies,
upon him who has made me, with him, like his Companions, one who blesses him.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
